Enlistment of chemist for supply of essential medicines (listed below as Annexure-I & Annexure-II) to the M edical Welfare Unit (MWU) of Indian Statistical Institute (ISI), Kolkata. Scope of Work: i. The medicines to be supplied to the Medical Welfare Unit, as per the drug listed in Annexure-I & Annexure-II. In case of confusion signed version of the required medicine uploaded with the tender would be considered as final. ii. The expiry date of medicines should not fall within one calendar year from the date of supply. iii. Medicine with short expiry will be accepted only in case of extreme emergency. Medicines supplied with a short expiry need to be replaced with new medicine if it remains unused. iv. Medical Welfare Unit (MWU) will place the quarterly requisition to the selected vendor & the medicines have to be supplied within 10 days of the receipt of the requisition from MWU. v. In case of emergencies medicines have to be supplied within 3 days. vi. RMO’s of the Institute will be the controlling Authority under the scope of the contract. vii. The supplier need to collect the requisition from Medical Welfare Unit of ISI and supply the medicine at the Medical Welfare Unit at own cost. No extra charges will be paid by ISI. viii. Triplicate copies of the bill along with triplicate copies of challan are needed to be submitted at the MWU. ix. ISI will be at a liberty to undertake random testing of supplied medicine for its quality and authenticity. x. ISI has the right to terminate the contract by giving 15 days’ notice in case of noncompliance within the provisions of the contract. xi. Payment on supply of medicine will be paid by account transfer mode only. xii. Payment will be made after satisfactory execution of the order as per the terms and conditions of the supply order within 45 days of receipt of the bill. xiii. No advance payment will be made. xiv. The selected vendors shall have to promptly reply to all the enquiries, execute orders as per the order of Institute. The contract may be terminated at 3rd instance of penalty on account of non-delivery/ partial delivery/ del ayed delivery etc. Documents to be uploaded by the seller: To be eligible for award of contract, Bidder must possess following Certificates / Test Reports on the date of bid opening (to be uploaded with bid): 1)Valid Drug License 2) Registration Certificate of the Firm 3)GST Registration Certificate in the state of consignee
